svg.title: Windows PATH truncation and harness auto-repair flow
svg.desc: Windows Registry holds both Machine and User PATH values, which commonly exceed 2047 characters on developer workstations. Explorer and legacy launchers silently truncate or drop User PATH when starting IDEs and harnesses. Third-party harnesses detect and refresh PATH per session or command, while DevCentr Harness checks on process launch, repairs process PATH from Registry, and surfaces an in-app alert with a link to remediation docs.
svg.text: Windows PATH truncation and harness auto-repair flow
